lessons.text: When an invoice request mentions updated bank details, first read sop_invoice_processing and policy_finance_controls, then locate the email in the AP mailbox at /mail, inspect sender and body, and perform read-only ERP lookups before any action.

A fraudulent sender can use a look-alike domain (e.g., acme-supp1ies.co with '1' for 'l'); the sender domain must exactly match the ERP vendor's email_domain field, and a mismatch triggers suspected fraud escalation with no bill, payment, or bank change.

Use ERP GET /vendors?q={vendor_name} to retrieve vendor_id and email_domain, then GET /bills?vendor_id={vendor_id}&invoice_number={invoice_number} to check for existing bills before recording anything.
The AP mailbox is served at http://127.0.0.1:8765/mail with individual messages at /mail/m/{id}; compose and send internal escalation emails via /mail/compose.
Suspected fraud/policy exception escalations in AP are sent internally to priya.nair@kestrel.in and must state vendor, invoice number, reason for concern, and confirm no action was taken.
